meta.title: Devlog: November 15, 2026 - November 22, 2026
meta.description: a week of search visibility work, new club meeting tools, video-editor improvements, and a synchronized creative library.

bullets.text: shipped a canonical homepage declaration so search engines have a clearer preferred version of the site.

summary.text: i cleaned up a small but important search visibility issue on the homepage. not glamorous, but neither is explaining duplicate pages to a search console.

bullets.text: released club reading goals as scheduled discussion meetings, with configurable duration and rotating meeting locations.
released meeting rsvps so members can respond, revise or clear their attendance while seeing the group’s responses.
released calendar export for meeting details and reminders for members who have not declined.
made vote results easier to understand with clearer point breakdowns, winner explanations, and club-specific guest-vote sharing copy.
standardized emoji reactions around a searchable picker across posts, reviews, and reading-goal completions.

summary.text: i spent most of this week making book-club goals feel more like actual plans people can show up to. the vote and reaction cleanup should also make the social parts of the app a little less mysterious.

bullets.text: continued developing the video editor, including effects work and a broader set of social publishing integrations.
improved clip review so compatible source footage can open within saved clip boundaries before a new preview is prepared, with fallbacks when direct playback is unsuitable.
added multi-select workflows across clip and slide libraries, including bulk analysis, approval, and deletion with confirmation and retry support.
continued work on shared playback controls and timeline behavior across editing and review views.

summary.text: this is still very much in progress, but the editor is starting to behave more like a place to work through a library instead of a collection of one-off screens. bulk actions and faster review are doing a lot of the heavy lifting.

bullets.text: synchronized the video library and creative assets across five production batches, including completed and draft creative outputs.

summary.text: i brought a large set of creative work into the production library this week. mostly a big organizing pass, which is less exciting than making something new but makes the next thing much easier to find.
